definition: Low-voltage transistor-transistor logic defines digital signal-level conventions associated with TTL-compatible operation at reduced supply voltages.
entry_text: Low-voltage transistor-transistor logic defines digital signal-level conventions associated with TTL-compatible operation at reduced supply voltages.
